clarification: Please give the patient's age in completed years.

wording: Is the patient having any difficulty breathing right now?
clarification: Please answer yes, no, don't know, or prefer not to answer. Pain or irritation is different from difficulty breathing.

wording: Can the patient swallow their saliva?
clarification: Can they swallow saliva, even if it hurts, or are they unable to swallow it?

wording: When did the {symptom_label} start, and about how long has it been present?
clarification: Please give your best estimate for when the {symptom_label} started. It is also fine to say you don't know.

wording: Is the {symptom_label} getting better, getting worse, or staying about the same?
clarification: For the {symptom_label}, is it better, worse, or about the same compared with when it started?

wording: Has the patient's temperature been measured? If so, what was the reading, unit, and when was it measured?
clarification: Please include the number and whether it was Celsius or Fahrenheit, if known. A partial answer will be kept.

wording: Does the patient have a runny nose?
clarification: Is the nose running? A blocked nose by itself is not recorded as a runny nose.

wording: Is the patient drinking about their usual amount of fluids?
clarification: Would you describe fluid intake as usual, reduced, or unknown?

wording: Has there been any change in how often or how much the patient urinates?
clarification: Please answer no change, less, more, don't know, or prefer not to answer.

wording: Does the patient have any ongoing medical conditions?
clarification: You can list them, say none, say you don't know, or prefer not to answer.

wording: Is the patient currently taking any medicines?
clarification: Please list them if known. An unnamed medicine can be recorded as unidentified.

wording: Has the patient recently been around smoke or a lot of dust?
clarification: Please answer for known recent exposure; the prototype will not infer it from a job or address.
